## History

Evans was a performer who gave a recitation at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) benefit concert. Their impressive delivery caused [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to experience a brief wave of severe stage fright after watching them perform.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII.
